posts.title: A Better CFP
posts.description: It’s that time of the year again. How SHOULD the college football playoff look. It’s not all that dissimilar from the current playoff in structure. It’s just about how teams are selected and seeded. The TLDR is that all conference champs get in. The top 4 conference champs get byes.
